en.title: Health Scan
en.summary: Read-only inventory of disk, services, leftover startup tasks, power, WSL and Office policy.
en.does: Runs WMI/CIM checks and writes a JSON report with severity-ranked findings.
en.doesNot: Does not change settings, install packages, or apply fixes.
en.expect: Actionable report in Health tab; review before applying anything.
en.tip: Prefer this over 'Scan + Apply' unless you already reviewed findings.

it.title: Scansione Salute
it.summary: Inventario read-only di disco, servizi, residui di avvio, alimentazione, WSL e policy Office.
it.does: Esegue controlli WMI/CIM e scrive un report JSON con finding per severità.
it.doesNot: Non modifica impostazioni, non installa pacchetti, non applica fix.
it.expect: Report consultabile nel tab Salute; rivedi prima di applicare.
it.tip: Preferisci questa azione rispetto a 'Scansiona + Applica' se non hai ancora rivisto i finding.

en.title: Scan + Apply Fixes
en.summary: Health scan followed by automatic fixes up to the selected MAX FIX level.
en.does: Runs audit then apply-safe-fixes for each finding (one best solution per finding).
en.doesNot: Does not replace manual review for Moderate/Aggressive items (services, startup, registry).
en.expect: Some items fixed automatically; others may need reboot or admin.
en.tip: Use Safe level only unless you understand each finding. Review Health tab first when possible.

it.title: Scansiona + Applica Fix
it.summary: Scansione salute seguita da fix automatici fino al livello FIX MAX selezionato.
it.does: Esegue audit poi apply-safe-fixes per ogni finding (una soluzione migliore per finding).
it.doesNot: Non sostituisce la revisione manuale per item Moderate/Aggressive (servizi, avvio, registry).
it.expect: Alcuni item corretti in automatico; altri possono richiedere reboot o admin.
it.tip: Usa livello Safe salvo conoscenza dei finding. Preferisci prima Scansione Salute.

en.title: Startup Integrity
en.summary: Finds leftover scheduled tasks and Run keys from old hub installs (missing -File paths).
en.does: Scans Task Scheduler, Run/RunOnce, Startup folders. Safe apply unregisters stale one-shot hub tasks and retargets suite tasks to the current hub root.
en.doesNot: Does not remove vendor autostart (Adobe, VMware, Sophos, Defender).
en.expect: JSON report in logs/startup-integrity-latest.json; Health Scan surfaces STARTUP-LEGACY-001.
en.tip: After moving the repo off C:, run this once elevated, or use Health Scan + Apply Safe.

it.title: Integrità avvio
it.summary: Trova task e chiavi Run residui di vecchie installazioni hub (percorsi -File mancanti).
it.does: Analizza Utilità di pianificazione, Run/RunOnce, cartelle Esecuzione automatica. Apply Safe rimuove i one-shot obsoleti e riallinea i task della suite alla root hub attuale.
it.doesNot: Non rimuove l'avvio automatico di vendor (Adobe, VMware, Sophos, Defender).
it.expect: Report JSON in logs/startup-integrity-latest.json; Health Scan mostra STARTUP-LEGACY-001.
it.tip: Dopo lo spostamento del repo da C:, eseguilo una volta da amministratore, oppure Scansione Salute + Applica Safe.

en.title: Scan Storage
en.summary: Classifies what occupies a selected drive: safe-delete, system/app-bound, personal HITL.
en.does: Walks the selected volume (not only typical install paths), scores files, samples magic bytes/NTFS cluster/LCN, exports CSV+JSON.
en.doesNot: Does not delete on Scan. SafeDelete files are removed only via ExecuteSafeDelete / Quick Clean.
en.expect: Ranked explorer rows tagged SafeDelete / SystemBound / AppBound / PersonalHitl.
en.tip: Pick the drive first. BitLevel adds magic-byte + cluster allocation (not a full bitstream crawl).

it.title: Analizza Spazio
it.summary: Classifica cosa occupa l'unità scelta: eliminabile, di sistema/app, personale HITL.
it.does: Percorre il volume (non solo path tipici), campiona magic-byte/cluster NTFS, esporta CSV+JSON.
it.doesNot: La scansione non cancella. I SafeDelete si eliminano solo con ExecuteSafeDelete / Quick Clean.
it.expect: Lista in Home con classi SafeDelete / SystemBound / AppBound / PersonalHitl.
it.tip: Seleziona prima l'unità. BitLevel = magic-byte + allocazione cluster, non uno scan bit-a-bit del disco.

en.title: Quick Clean
en.summary: Fast cleanup of temp, cache and old logs (current user + system paths).
en.does: Deletes files older than retention in safe targets; writes JSON log.
en.doesNot: Does not touch WinSxS, browser profiles, or Tier-2 whitelist paths.
en.expect: Modest GB reclaimed; safe for daily use.
en.tip: Run Scan Storage first if you need to see where space is before deleting.

it.title: Pulizia Rapida
it.summary: Pulizia veloce di temp, cache e log vecchi (utente corrente + percorsi di sistema).
it.does: Elimina file oltre retention in target sicuri; scrive log JSON.
it.doesNot: Non tocca WinSxS, profili browser o path whitelist Tier-2.
it.expect: Recupero modesto in GB; adatto uso quotidiano.
it.tip: Esegui prima Analizza Spazio se vuoi capire dove si perde spazio.

en.title: Privacy Scan
en.summary: Read-only search for plaintext passwords, API keys and connection strings.
en.does: Regex scan on configured paths; redacted previews in JSON/GUI.
en.doesNot: Does not move secrets to vault yet (Phase 2). Does not modify scanned files.
en.expect: Findings list with file, line, redacted preview. Manual review required.
en.tip: Exclude noisy folders in config Privacy.ExcludeDirNames.

it.title: Scansione Privacy
it.summary: Ricerca read-only di password, API key e connection string in chiaro.
it.does: Scan regex su path configurati; anteprime redatte in JSON/GUI.
it.doesNot: Non sposta segreti nel vault (Fase 2). Non modifica i file scansionati.
it.expect: Lista finding con file, riga, anteprima redatta. Revisione manuale richiesta.
it.tip: Escludi cartelle rumorose in config Privacy.ExcludeDirNames.

en.title: Storage Audit
en.summary: Simulates storage cleanup — reports what would be deleted.
en.does: Walks retention targets, counts reclaimable files, no deletion.
en.doesNot: Does not empty recycle bin or delete in audit mode.
en.expect: JSON report; use Storage Clean to execute.
en.tip: Radical mode includes more targets — always audit first.

it.title: Audit Storage
it.summary: Simula pulizia storage — riporta cosa verrebbe eliminato.
it.does: Percorre target retention, conta file recuperabili, nessuna cancellazione.
it.doesNot: Non svuota cestino né elimina in modalità audit.
it.expect: Report JSON; usa Pulizia Storage per eseguire.
it.tip: Modalità Radical include più target — audit sempre prima.

en.title: Storage Clean
en.summary: Deletes old temp/logs per retention rules (Safe or Radical mode).
en.does: Removes files from configured paths; clears recycle bin on execute.
en.doesNot: Does not run DISM, compact OS, or clean entire user profiles as SYSTEM.
en.expect: GB reclaimed varies; rollback JSON in logs before apply.
en.tip: Skips Windows Update cache if wuauserv is running.

it.title: Pulizia Storage
it.summary: Elimina temp/log vecchi secondo retention (Safe o Radical).
it.does: Rimuove file da path configurati; svuota cestino in execute.
it.doesNot: Non esegue DISM, compact OS o pulizia completa profili utente come SYSTEM.
it.expect: GB recuperati variabili; rollback JSON in logs.
it.tip: Salta cache Windows Update se wuauserv è in esecuzione.

en.title: Process Pressure Intelligence
en.summary: Deterministic CPU/RAM/IO hog detection with vital-process preservation and safe auto/HITL actions.
en.does: Two-snapshot scoring, necessity classification (Keep/Tune/Review), catalog research links, optional safe priority throttle via apply script.
en.doesNot: Does not terminate vital/security processes; aggressive actions require HITL.
en.expect: ProcessPressureReport.v1 JSON with Summary and RecommendedActions.
en.tip: Run apply-process-pressure-safe.ps1 -MaxLevel Safe after review for reversible throttles only.

it.title: Process Pressure Intelligence
it.summary: Rilevamento deterministico hog CPU/RAM/IO con preservazione processi vitali e azioni safe/HITL.
it.does: Scoring a due snapshot, classificazione necessità (Keep/Tune/Review), link ricerca catalogo, throttle priorità reversibile opzionale.
it.doesNot: Non termina processi vitali/sicurezza; azioni aggressive richiedono HITL.
it.expect: JSON ProcessPressureReport.v1 con Summary e RecommendedActions.
it.tip: Dopo review esegui apply-process-pressure-safe.ps1 -MaxLevel Safe solo per throttle reversibili.

en.title: NVMe Advisor
en.summary: Read-only wear/risk heuristics and generic offload checklist.
en.does: Reads physical disk reliability counters when available.
en.doesNot: Does not relocate data or change write patterns automatically.
en.expect: Plan text; SMART may be empty under RAID/RST.
en.tip: Use with vendor tools (CrystalDiskInfo) for ground truth.

it.title: Consulente NVMe
it.summary: Euristica usura/rischio read-only e checklist offload generica.
it.doesNot: Non sposta dati né cambia pattern di scrittura in automatico.
it.expect: Testo piano; SMART spesso vuoto con RAID/RST.
it.tip: Affianca tool vendor (CrystalDiskInfo) per dati certi.

en.title: VMware Health
en.summary: Inventory VMware Workstation VMs, diagnose MKS/mksSandbox crashes, locks, and 3D settings.
en.does: Scans configurable roots (e.g. D:\Macchine_Virtuali), reads vmware.log / mksSandbox logs, reports stale locks and host pressure.
en.doesNot: Does not delete .vmdk/snapshots, force power-off, or run vm-support unless you apply safe repairs explicitly.
en.expect: JSON VmwareHealthReport.v1 in logs/vmware-health-latest.json; GUI dry-run by default.
en.tip: For ISBRendererComm/mksSandbox crashes: power off VM, then Apply to disable 3D (backed-up .vmx) and clear only verified stale locks.

it.title: Salute VMware
it.summary: Inventario VM VMware Workstation, diagnosi crash MKS/mksSandbox, lock e impostazioni 3D.
it.does: Scansiona root configurabili (es. D:\Macchine_Virtuali), legge vmware.log / mksSandbox, segnala lock obsoleti e pressione host.
it.doesNot: Non elimina .vmdk/snapshot, non spegne VM forzatamente, non esegue vm-support salvo apply esplicito dei repair safe.
it.expect: JSON VmwareHealthReport.v1 in logs/vmware-health-latest.json; dalla GUI default dry-run.
it.tip: Per crash ISBRendererComm/mksSandbox: spegni la VM, poi Applica per disabilitare il 3D (.vmx con backup) e pulire solo lock verificati come stale.

en.title: Partition Plan
en.summary: Checks legacy WinRE partition reclaim (disk 1 / part 4 defaults).
en.does: Evidence chain for GPT recovery partition layout.
en.doesNot: Does not guarantee safe apply on non-matching layouts.
en.expect: Audit safe; Apply is destructive — full backup required.
en.tip: Default disk/partition numbers are wrong on most PCs — audit only unless verified.

it.title: Piano Partizioni
it.summary: Verifica reclaim partizione WinRE legacy (default disco 1 / part 4).
it.does: Catena evidenze per layout partizione recovery GPT.
it.doesNot: Non garantisce apply sicuro su layout non corrispondenti.
it.expect: Audit sicuro; Apply distruttivo — backup completo obbligatorio.
it.tip: Default disco/partizione spesso errati — solo audit salvo verifica.

en.title: Pkg Prerequisites
en.summary: Audit for missing PKG-* items then apply Safe solutions only.
en.does: Filters PKG findings; may open download pages or run ensure-powershell-core.
en.doesNot: Does not silently install all missing software — many fixes are links.
en.expect: Partial automation; manual install often still required.
en.tip: Read each PKG finding — 'Safe' may mean 'open browser' not 'install'.

it.title: Prerequisiti Pkg
it.summary: Audit item PKG-* mancanti poi applica solo soluzioni Safe.
it.does: Filtra finding PKG; può aprire pagine download o ensure-powershell-core.
it.doesNot: Non installa silenziosamente tutto — molti fix sono link.
it.expect: Automazione parziale; spesso serve install manuale.
it.tip: Leggi ogni finding PKG — 'Safe' può significare 'apri browser'.

en.title: Run Health Scan (Health tab)
en.summary: Same engine as Home Health Scan — manual apply per finding.
en.does: Full audit JSON for Health tab with per-finding Apply Selected Fix.
en.doesNot: Does not auto-apply (unlike old Health Check button behavior).
en.expect: Best path: scan here, review, apply one fix at a time.
en.tip: This is the recommended workflow for fixes.

it.title: Avvia Scansione (tab Salute)
it.summary: Stesso motore di Scansione Salute — apply manuale per finding.
it.does: Audit JSON completo per tab Salute con Applica Fix Selezionato.
it.doesNot: Non auto-applica (a differenza del vecchio Health Check).
it.expect: Percorso consigliato: scansiona, rivedi, applica un fix alla volta.

en.title: Install Core
en.summary: Ensures PowerShell 7 and registers background monitor + daily cleanup tasks.
en.does: Installs pwsh if missing; creates SYSTEM scheduled tasks.
en.doesNot: Does not uninstall tasks or explain monitor throttling behavior in UI.
en.expect: Background monitor may lower process priority after threshold hits.
en.tip: Review monitor-resources.ps1 AutoTerminate setting in config before install.

it.title: Installa Core
it.summary: Assicura PowerShell 7 e registra task monitor + cleanup giornaliero.
it.does: Installa pwsh se assente; crea scheduled task SYSTEM.
it.doesNot: Non disinstalla task né spiega throttling monitor in UI.
it.expect: Monitor in background può abbassare priorità processi oltre soglia.
it.tip: Rivedi AutoTerminate in config prima di installare.
